final: WITH team_sums AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(g - w) AS team_sum FROM manager GROUP BY team_id), overall AS (SELECT SUM(team_sum) AS total FROM team_sums), team_average AS (SELECT AVG(team_sum) AS avg_sum FROM team_sums), kept AS (SELECT ts.team_sum, ts.team_sum * 1.0 / o.total AS share, a.avg_sum FROM team_sums AS ts JOIN overall AS o ON o.total IS NOT NULL JOIN team_average AS a ON a.avg_sum IS NOT NULL WHERE ts.team_sum > a.avg_sum) SELECT AVG(team_sum) AS average_kept_sum, AVG(share) AS average_kept_share, AVG(team_sum - avg_sum) AS average_excess FROM kept
